newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Big Three Banks up on dividend issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Big Three Banks up on dividend issue.

text.p: Taiwan's Big Three state-run banks -- Chang Hwa, First Commercial and Hua Nan -- surged in early Thursday trading after the banks issued stock dividends of T$5, T$5 and T$2, respectively.
Chang Hwa and First Commercial both rose the daily seven percent limit to T$126 and T$126.5, respectively, and Hua Nan surged T$6 or 5.36 percent to T$118.

"Financials had lagged the overall market gains in the past year. After the dividend issue, the Big Three's prices are comparatively cheap, thus attracting bargain hunting," said United Securities manager Lin Long-hsien.
Brokers said they do not expect the banks' shares to rise much further because their profit prospects are not good.

"Right now, the market's bellwether shares are electronics, which have shown sound sales and profit performance, but the Big Three banks are not expected to enjoy high profit returns in the near future," said Michael Hung, an independent senior analyst.
